text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr was chosen to be featured in a magazine special about racewear.
I accompanied her to the interview, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
My, seeing your racing racewear up close
makes it look even cuter~!
Now then, let's see a cute pose!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Cute...
Just like the flower-bearing spring breeze, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Is the motif flowers?
It's so soft and fluffy, perfectly fitting for the lovely Zephyr-san!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"This is the wind.
It's the embodiment of the ideal I yearn to become—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see, like the wind! It certainly has a wonderful, refreshing feel to it, just like a gentle breeze!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr nodded along, as if to say, "I see that is how it is for you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching over her, I recalled the time
we decided on the design for her Racewear.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A motif to incorporate into your racewear... is it?
choice_data_list: A lot of girls pour their dreams and ideals into it, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Dreams and ideals... If that is so, then I am the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A wind so free, pure, and vivid,
reminiscent of the breeze felt at races watched in the past.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Strong and swift, I want to become like
that gale of wind that swept my heart away."
choice_data_list: Then let's go check out that racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place Yamanin Zephyr once yearned for—
visiting it will surely bring the design of
her racing racewear into sharper focus.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I listen closely and close my eyes...
the wind and the scenery of that day come vividly back to life.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Watching the frills sway freely with the gale,
tracking the trail of ribbons dancing in the air—
my heart danced and soared just like the morning breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...!
This wind is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Both past and present, a magnificent breeze always blows through here."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My feelings, too...
continue to blow within my heart, unchanged from back then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"An unchanging yearning, a steady and unwavering wind...
Surely that is the kind of wind my racing silks represent."
choice_data_list: Looks like it's going to be a wonderful racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering her proud smile from back then,
I'm overcome with the desire to not let this photoshoot end
on a misunderstanding.
choice_data_list: Let's show them how we run, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr's wind is stronger, faster, and more captivating to onlookers than the reporters realize. —That is what I asserted.
choice_data_list: Zephyr is more than just a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You... took the wind that is me head-on,
feeling it just as it is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san! Excuse me, but
would it be all right if we took
another photo of you!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was mistaken.
Your wind is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Calling it a 'gentle breeze' was far too mild... was that it?"
choice_data_list: Looks like they understood your wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...However, I will become an even stronger,
more majestic wind than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Running with utter freedom,
so that one day, she might finally reach her ideal."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like the wind that swept my heart away in that moment—
together with this racing silk,
I shall run like a furious gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san! Excuse me, but
would it be all right if we took
another photo of you!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was mistaken.
Your wind is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Calling it a 'gentle breeze' was far too mild... was that it?"
choice_data_list: It seems your wind reached their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean I am drawing closer to that wind, little by little?
...If so, it is truly a wind of light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr looked proud
as she gazed at her strong, dignified self
featured in the magazine.
